observations: Photo 0 shows what appears to be two separate used car engines (or engine long-blocks) sitting on bare ground/workshop floor.
Wiring harnesses, intake manifolds, and valve covers are visible on both units, with dirt/grease and disconnected cables hanging loose.
One valve cover in the left engine appears to show partial lettering that could read 'FORD' but is not fully clear or sharp.
The right engine's cover also has embossed/painted text, but it is blurred and not legible enough to confirm any brand or model.
No engine code plate, VIN sticker, or chassis tag is visible in the photo.
A person's legs/feet are visible in the background on a raised platform, suggesting an open-air spare parts yard.
No photos of the engines running, no compression test, no oil condition, and no mileage or odometer shown.

identity.kind: used car engine / engine long-block (possibly two separate units)

claims.claim: We also deal on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim, not tied to this specific item; no shop signage or inventory shown.

risks.risk: Engine make/model cannot be confirmed, which drives price enormously (e.g., Ford vs. other brands).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the engine code plate, casting numbers, or VIN sticker on the block.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic used engine, lowest tier

risks.risk: Engine could be non-functional, cracked block, or missing internal parts (pistons, crank) since it's pulled and sitting disassembled.
risks.proof: Video of engine running/starting, or compression test reading, or at minimum oil/coolant condition photos.

risks.risk: Mileage and prior accident/flood damage history unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of mileage sticker, service history, or import documentation (if Tokunbo/used import).
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, worst case

risks.risk: Completeness of the engine (turbo, sensors, injectors, wiring loom) cannot be verified from a cluttered photo.
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos showing full engine bay sides, turbo, and harness connectors intact.

risks.risk: Possible mismatch — two different engines shown together may be sold separately or as a confusing bundle.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation and separate photos per engine with matching listing description.
risks.if_unproven: priced as single lower-value unit only, pending clarification

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the engine code plate or casting number on each block.
A video of the engine cranking/running (if claimed functional).
Full side and top views of each engine separately, including intake, exhaust manifold, and connector harness.
Any paperwork or import sticker showing mileage/origin.
response.reason: The photo shows unidentified used engine(s) with no legible brand, model, or code plate, and no proof of working condition, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without clearer identification shots.
